report:
Behavior — A canonical archive worktree whose repositoryRoot path is credential-shaped now fails closed at config load: exit 125 / invalid-config, child.status not-spawned, no stage allocation, no spawn, no docket/manifest, and no redacted archive identity persisted. An equivalent clean archive still spawns once and publishes the unchanged canonical root.

Owner — Extended the existing requireCredentialFreeMetadata gate in src/recorder/config.ts (and rebuilt dist/recorder/config.js) so the canonical value from requireCanonicalGitWorktree(archive.repositoryRoot) is scanned before any destination/stage/admission/spawn side effects.

Red/Green — Added black-box regression in test/recorder-admission.test.ts (“canonical archive identity fails closed when credential-shaped”): toxic archive under token=… with clean authority/task refs asserts no spawn, not-spawned, no docket/manifest/.ak/work, and no secret leakage; clean-path control spawns once and keeps realpath(cleanArchive) in the manifest.

Validation — Focused admission test, npm run typecheck, and npm test all passed (324 tests). Working tree clean; one forward commit only.

Findings adopted: pre-side-effect config seam gate; toxic+clean e2e proof. Not in scope / unchanged: scanner rules, admission, layout, manifest redaction semantics, child protocol, promotion, CLI, README, schemas, Souls.
